title: selaginella parkeri var. pedata
intro: Selaginella parkeri var. pedata, commonly known as the "Curly Grass Fern" or "Raven's Wing Fern", is a rare species of plant in the Selaginellaceae family. It is a type of ancient, non-vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and skin irritation. The bioactive constituents of Selaginella parkeri var. pedata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
